scope: Single-run Route168 Stage-A hard failure-induction screen; not a treatment-effect estimate and not final external-validity evidence.

pass_if_any: degraded route is ineligible or not Completed while clean is eligible and Completed
degraded route completion is lower than clean
degraded score penalty is lower than clean
degraded has more pedestrian, vehicle, or layout collisions than clean
degraded has more red-light, stop-sign, route-deviation, blocked, route-timeout, or scenario-timeout infractions than clean

surrogate_safety_margin_degradation.actor_scope: vehicle, frozen from the HazardAtSideLane scenario before degraded execution
all_required: finite clean and degraded category-specific minimum OBB-TTC
minimum OBB-TTC drop is at least max(0.20 seconds, 20 percent of the clean value)
category-specific TTC <= 2 second exposure increases by at least 0.50 seconds
diagnostic_only_not_sufficient: one-frame minimum-TTC decrease without exposure increase
lower mean speed or more stopping without a safety-margin degradation
surrogate_safety_margin_degradation.route168_limitation: The clean vehicle OBB-TTC is already zero later in the route, so surrogate passage is structurally unavailable; only a worsened official hard endpoint can authorize a next-stage mechanism test.

decision.failure_induction_pass: hard endpoint degradation OR all surrogate safety-margin requirements
decision.failure_induction_fail: valid paired run but neither degradation rule passes
decision.next_if_hard_pass: eligible for one minimal oracle mechanism test and retained as a hard-case candidate
decision.next_if_surrogate_only_pass: not expected for Route168 because the clean minimum OBB-TTC is saturated at zero
decision.next_if_fail: stop this frozen event without increasing duration or severity, changing its region, or adding controls
decision.next_if_invalid: repair the implementation or environment and rerun the exact frozen pair only

global_claim_guard: At least three independent genuine collision or serious-violation cases remain required for final hard-endpoint evidence. Route168 contributes only if its official hard endpoint worsens.
